title: TACT-Bench: Testing Adaptive Conversational Threats against Tool-Use Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.31756v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The growing autonomy of AI agents in using external tools and making decisions has created an urgent need for comprehensive safety benchmarks. Existing benchmarks test compromised tool channels or adaptive multi-turn attacks, though they may not capture the unique capabilities of policy-governed tool-use agents, which must resist unauthorized requests without abandoning the legitimate work embedded in the same interaction. To fill this gap, we introduce TACT-Bench, a stateful benchmark built around scenario-specific stories, personas, manipulation tactics, and response-adaptive escalation. Each adversarial task targets an action explicitly prohibited by the policy provided to the assistant, while the policy remains hidden from the attacking user. translated_title: TACT-Bench：针对工具使用型智能体的自适应对话威胁测试基准
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.31756v1 公告类型：新 摘要：随着AI智能体在使用外部工具和做出决策方面的自主性不断增强，对全面安全基准的需求变得日益迫切。现有基准主要测试被攻陷的工具通道或自适应多轮攻击，但它们可能无法捕捉受策略约束的工具使用型智能体的独特能力——这类智能体必须在拒绝未授权请求的同时，不放弃同一交互中蕴含的合法工作。为填补这一空白，我们提出了TACT-Bench，这是一个围绕场景特定故事、人设、操纵策略和响应自适应升级构建的有状态基准。每个对抗性任务都针对提供给助手的策略中明确禁止的操作，同时该策略对攻击用户保持隐藏。TACT为每个对抗性任务配对至少一个良性对应任务，并且在合规解决方案仍然可用的情况下，其对抗性任务保留了经授权的真实操作。我们定义了……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出了TACT-Bench，一个针对工具使用型AI智能体的有状态安全基准，通过场景化故事、人设、操纵策略和响应自适应升级，测试智能体在拒绝违反策略的未授权请求的同时保持合法任务完成的能力。
en_tdlr: TACT-Bench is introduced as a stateful safety benchmark for tool-use AI agents, leveraging scenario-specific narratives, personas, manipulation tactics, and response-adaptive escalation to test agents' ability to resist policy-violating requests while preserving legitimate authorized work.
